comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-685 drives a wing corkscrew into a cork and extracts it while the bottle remains in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex driver and thin wrench for coupled countertorque; PR-685 performs helical insertion followed by lever-powered high-force extraction and bottle stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a stable 90° opening across cycles; PR-685 requires the cork fully removed and displaced while the bottle stays within cradle-motion limits.
comparison.reason: Shared rotary tool use is generic; cork penetration and extraction do not test locknut tightening without calibration drift, and all rubric details are present.
